answer: Reusable Work Credential (RWC): each agent’s key accrues non-transferable, task-specific credits from independently audited outputs. Credits unlock lighter verification—ivory-tier spot checks—while new keys start at ferrous-tier full audit and only reach marble-tier trust after sustained correct work. A clone must repeat that audited workload before earning at parity; an honest agent amortizes one history across many jobs. Attacker cost is full verification compute plus delayed revenue per clone, scaling linearly with clone count.
